Hardcase was a member of the Squad, the first four ultrahumans the world has ever known. In their last battle against an inhuman foe, two members of the Squad died while another remained in a coma and the only one to survive was Hardcase. The incident caused him to change careers and become an actor. While on the set of one of his movies, he is approached by a police officer that wants an autograph and inquires why Hardcase won't return to being a superhero. Before their conversation concludes, the police officer is summoned to a bank robbery. Hardcase declines to join him and the police officer rushes ahead. As Hardcase films his next scene, he can hear gunshots from the bank robbery and goes to investigate. There he meets Head Knocker, another super-powered ultra, who is trying to rob the bank and killed several people. He defeats Hard Knocker and decides he is out of retirement, pursuing his career as a crime fighter again.

issue_title: The Angry Past, Part One: Agent Snowdon
description: Aladdin, the government agency created to keep track of ultras, has bugs set up in the home of Hardcase. Aladdin surveillance agents learn of the Alternate but have no idea who or what it is. Hardcase gets back to living his life by going to ceremony awards and giving interviews on television. Choice and Hardcase begin a romantic relationship and Choice confides in him that she is starting to remember some of her memories, but the memories reveal two distinctly different childhoods: one is from Vietnam and the other is from America. The Alternate told Hardcase and Choice that the answers Choice seeks lays in the headquarters of Aladdin, so they decide to visit the headquarters again. Meanwhile, an agent of Aladdin recruits both Hardwire and Head Knocker to join on a mission to defeat Hardcase and to make certain he does not reach the Aladdin base. The two criminals are joined with Dirt Devil, Foxfire and War Eagle. The Aladdin crew meet up with Choice and Hardcase in the middle of a deserted road, a battle sure to come.

Hardcase and Choice are in Hardcase's car, headed towards the secret base of Aladdin, when they are met with Aladdin agents Foxfire, Dirt Devil and War Eagle. Head Knocker and Hardwire accompany the crew, being made temporary Aladdin agents. Hardcase immediately turns around and the Aladdin agents are bewildered that their mere presence caused the hero to surrender. However, the real reason was because Hardcase did not want another of his cars destroyed in an ultra fight. Foxfire, Dirt Devil and War Eagle chase after them and a large battle ensues. Head Knocker and Hardwire return back to the base to bide their time and strike against Hardcase and Choice at a better time. Choice and Hardcase finally defeat Foxfire, Dirt Devil and War Eagle and feel tired when they are finally met with Hardwire and Head Knocker.

Hardcase and Choice battle the combined might of Hardwire and Head Knocker. The battle lasts for a while before Hardcase and Choice escape. They catch Foxfire, War Eagle and Dirt Devil in the desert and tell them that they want to conclude a truce: Hardcase won't attempt to enter Aladdin's base if Aladdin does not retaliate in any manner. Aladdin agrees and they leave the scene. Unfortunately, Aladdin also loses Hardwire and Head Knocker, letting loose two convicted killers. After some time, Hardcase and Choice find themselves in Las Vegas where they contact Tech of the Solution. Hardcase asks Tech to search the database of Aladdin's computers to find the secrets behind Choice's memory. Tech unfortunately reveals that they took part of Choice's brain out and replaced it with brain matter from Starburst's brian, the ex-girlfriend of Hardcase, to make her an ultra.

Hardcase and Choice are reeling over the information that Tech of the Solution revealed to them. They learned that Choice was implanted with a section of Starburst's brain, an ultra, to give Choice ultra abilities. Tech is able to use her ultra ability of technopathy to get the top secret files from Aladdin, so Hardcase and Choice read the file in one sitting. The true history of Choice is finally revealed. After learning the information, Choice feels a flood of relief at finally knowing her past and being able to get past it. Just as she's celebrating this new freedom, she is teleported out of there, leaving behind a surprised Hardcase and Tech. Choice finds herself in a placed called Xurina, greeted by two aliens.

Hardcase and Tech deal with Choice simply disappearing before them. Tech calls her teammate, Shadowmage, to help find Choice. Using her magic, Shadowmage learns that the person who teleported Choice used magic and came from her very own home planet of Xurina. Meanwhile, Rex Mundi uses powers at his disposal to keep bugs in Hardcase's home, bugs that are neither magical or electronic in nature. Hardcase, Shadowmage and Tech go to Hardcase's home to see if they can find any more clues about Choice's disappearance, but they cannot. Hardcase files a report with the police department and vists his comatose ex-girlfriend, Starburst, in a hospital to tell her everything he has learned lately. While Hardcase is gone, Hardwire waits for him at his house for some revenge.

Hardcase arrives at his home to find it in disarray and disheveled. He is surprised by an attack by Hardwire, who has been dealt with defeat by Hardcase several times. The battle goes on for a while, being overlooked by Rex Mundi. Hardcase finally defeats Hardwire and goes into his kitchen to get something to drink when something lands in his house. Hardcase finds himself face to face with NM-E, the creature that destroyed the Squad and put his ex-girlfriend in a coma.

Hardcase finds NM-E in his home, ready to kill him. NM-E was the creature created and sent by Rex Mundi to destroy the Squad. The only survivor of that battle was Hardcase and NM-E is back to finish him off. The battle is fierce and violent, with NM-E getting the upper hand through the whole fight. Both Rex Mundi and the Alternate, eternal foes, look upon the battle in earnest. Before NM-E can deliver a finishing blow against Hardcase, who is hurt beyond belief, Prime arrives to save his friend and teammate.

Prime arrives to save Hardcase from a killing blow. While Prime battles NM-E on his own, Hardcase's body lays on the beach. The Alternate arrives to heal Hardcase and informs him about some special properties of his ultra ability, including the facts that sea water can heal him and he doesn't need air. Meanwhile, Prime finds NM-E to be stronger than he anticipated. Prime's protoplasmic shell eventually dissipates and it seems that NM-E is about to kill the teenager that is really Prime when Hardcase arrives to save him. While not complete healed, Hardcase is in fighting shape and vows to not stop until NM-E is destroyed. Meanwhile, Hardwire is saved by a mysyerious person in Hardcase's burning house. Rex Mundi also figures out that the Alternate directly intervened to save Hardcase's life and ponders on it.

Hardcase is burnt beyond recognition but continues to fight NM-E. Hardcase lured NM-E to a gas station where he puts the mechanical creature into a fiery explosion and then immediately places him in the cold water, the extreme temperatures hurting NM-E drastically. Hardcase continues to fight him and grabs one of his blades to finally destroy him again. Prime arrives, recovered, to help Hardcase again but NM-E is already defeated. Hardcase and Prime discuss that NM-E's parts should be sent to Contrary for observation when suddenly Hardcase is teleported away. He believes that Choice is teleporting him, much like she was teleported before. The Alternate and Rex Mundi are both confused about Hardcase's disappearance and the Alternate tries to figure a way to steal NM-E's mechanical parts away from Prime.

With Hardcase disappearing immediately after defeating NM-E, to the surprise of everyone, Prime tries to assess the situation he's now placed in. The Alternate, also at the scene, tries to figure a way to steal NM-E from under Prime's attention. Shape-shifting into the likeness of Mantra, a superheroine that Prime has an attraction to, The Alternate is able to take NM-E's robotic parts and then disappear with them. Prime tries to give chase, but soon loses her. Rex Mundi, the creator of NM-E, gets frustrated when he sees his arch-nemesis steal his greatest creation stolen. He arrives on Earth to gather his 'bugs', things he created to spy on Hardcase. Meanwhile, the Operator, one of Rex Mundi's associates, is a powerful woman on the West Coast that keeps observation on several operations. She gathers a meeting with her crew when she reveals that she knows one of them are betraying her. She then introduces her group to Trauma, a new ultra that has helped reveal the subterfuge.

A beautiful ultra named Choice is frantic and searches for Hardcase to help her. She is chased all the way to Hardcase's house by a group wearing advanced battle armor. Hardcase and Choice make quick work of the group and try to get answers, but none are really forthcoming. Choice has been programmed by the company she works so that she is unable to always reveal pertinent information but Hardcase decides to help her anyway.

Different people are reacting to Hardcase's disappearance. Turf vows vengeance against Hardcase, who was recently apprehended by him. The Omega Team try to pick up the pieces as mercenary killers after having faced several defeats against Hardcase. MEanwhile, Hardcase finds himself on the Godwheel where he fights for Ogma, a sentient computer program. Hardcase demands to be taken to Choice, who he hasn't seen in quite some time. Ogma sends him to Choice for a limited time. They reunite and she informs him that she is pregnant. They discuss their different missions before Hardcase is teleported away by Ogma. Hardcase eventually arrives at him home to find it demolished from his fights against Hardwire and NM-E. Everyone begins to take notice that Hardcase is back in a new outfit. Trouble of the Omega Team takes particular notice, wanting revenge.

Hardcase returns to Earth after his ordeal in the Godwheel. He finds his house from his battle against Hardwire and NM-E. He returns to his office to make calls to friends and family and his teammates in Ultraforce, but none of his friends or family are willing to allow him to live with them temporarily. Hardcase realizes that it's because he has enemies and they feel unsafe with Hardcase around. He decides to buy a mobile home while his house gets rebuilt. Hardcase decides now is the time to finally concentrate on taking down Rex Mundi, the source of all his turmoil. Unbeknown to Hardcase, he is being trailed by a time-displaced man who believes that he is Hardcase's son.

issue_title: Mundiquest, Part I of IV: Trouble
description: While Trauma uses her unique style of telekinesis to kill a former KGB agent, Hardcase speaks to Detective Chuck Brown to brief him on his current activites. He also tries to find out if Detective Brown had any information on the enigmatic Rex Mundi but Detective Brown only thought he was a myth or an urban legend. Hardcase decides to use the internet to hire mercenaries that were in the emply of Rex Mundi. He's able to get in contact with Trouble, a member of the Omega Team. They meet in a dingy bar where Hardcase pays Trouble for information on Rex. Trouble explains his connection with Rex Mundi but refuses the money; he wants Hardcase to kill Rex Mundi for this information. Unbeknown to both of them, Rex Mundi and Trauma are in the same bar observing. Before Trouble can reveal where to find Rex, Rex orders Trauma to kill Trouble with her telekinetic abilities, snapping his neck. She timed it perfect so it appeared that Hardcase killed Trouble. Hardcase suspects that Rex had something to do with it.

issue_title: Mundiquest, Part II of IV: Tempus Fugit
description: Loki, on the Godwheel, searches for the Infinity Gems and finds that some of them have landed in the Ultraverse. Hardcase, accused of killing Trouble, is questioned by police and then released since there is no evidence to incriminate him. Hardcase travels to the desert to think in meditation when he sees a meteor crash. He goes to investigate but it's actually the Time Gem. He places it on his head and immediately knows how to use it. He goes in the past to the last battle of the Squad, his former teammates, and tries to change fate. He travels back and follows where NM-E came from, so he could track Rex Mundi. When that proves fruitless, he helps the Squad defeat NM-E and travels back to his normal time. Expecting to find the Squad still alive, he is surprised when he finds that they still died due to another plan of Rex Mundi. He also finds out that due to the changes he caused, there is a different woman known as Choice working for the Choice Corporation. Loki suddenly arrives, demanding the Time Gem and telling Hardcase that he can cancel all of Hardcase's tampering with the time stream so that he can go back to his normal existence. Hardcase gives Loki the Time Gem but Loki tricks him, disappearing with the Gem.

issue_title: Mundiquest, Part III of IV: The Set Up
description:
Hardcase visits J.D. Hunt and scares him into revealing the location of Rex Mundi. When he goes to the secret location, Hardcase learns that it was a set-up because the building explodes. Hardcase then speaks to Tech of the Solution to find out where the Quattro may be. Shadowmage informs him where Death Dance and Meathook are. Hardcase goes to visit them and they attack him, thinking they're in a fight. After Hardcase resolves the confusion, Death Dance and Meathook informs him where they could find Rex. Meanwhile, the new Choice that Hardcase inadvertently 'created' by altering the time stream arrives at Hardcase's office to find him. At the same time, the real Choice arrives from Godwheel to find Hardcase's home in shambles.

Notes:

  • The cover is a homage to the cover of Amazing Fantasy #15.

issue_title: Mundiquest, Part IV of IV: The Threshold
description: Hardcase arrives to the mountain that Death Dance and Meathook directed him to find Rex Mundi. While there, creatures made of the earth rise from the ground and attack Hardcase. They battle for a while and Hardcase contemplates what the Alternate told him before, that he has powers he has no idea about. Suddenly the creatures in contact with him become frozen. Defeating the creatures, Hardcase finds a way into the mountain and then underground, to the lair of Rex Mundi. Meanwhile, the original Choice arrives to find Hardcase. She is surprised to find another woman taking the Choice identity, which makes her angry. She believes that the Choice Corporation cloned her and they both fight.

Hardcase finally confront Rex Mundi. Rex Mundi captures him and explains to him his origin. Rex Mundi is the world's first true ultra and he created the Alternate out of his own body, making an equal. The Alternate didn't agree with Rex Mundi's agenda of controlling the world and destroying all ultras because they were a risk to his agenda. The Alternate, Regina, opposed Rex Mundi since then. Rex Mundi created NM-E to be his ultra destroyer. While Rex reveals this information, Hardcase realizes that he's much more powerful than he thought. He uses this newfound power to time travel and stop his past self from saving the Squad. When that occurs, the original Choice kills the newest Choice. Hardcase arrives back in Rex Mundi's lair and is disrupted by an attack from the Alternate in NM-E's armor. The battle is waged as they release Hardcase from the lair. Realizing the fight was not his anymore and that he defeated Rex in his own way, Hardcase goes back to his office to find Choice there, ready to start a life together with him.

Choice is still with Hardcase and that makes the president of the Choice Corporation very nervous. He is counseled by J.D. Hunt and Rex Mundi. Rex Mundi decides to send the Omega Team, a group of mercenaries, to recapture Choice. Meanwhile, Hardcase and Choice are at Hardcase's home speaking with Detective Brown about the events that transpired earlier that day. When the media arrives, Hardcase and Choice leave the house and head to the beach. It's there that the Omega Team attacks, but they are eventually defeated. Tired, Hardcase and Choice return to Hardcase's home to find that the Strangers are there waiting for him.

The Strangers visit Hardcase for advice on how to be an ultra-human and a crime fighter. Hardcase regales the Strangers with his tale of the Squad, his old super-team, and of their unfortunate demise. When telling the story, Hardcase makes a realization that the monster that killed the Squad, NM-E, attacked very soon after the Squad rejected the government agency known as Aladdin. Electrocute informs everyone that she learned where Aladdin's headquarters with her time with J.D. Hunt. Hardcase, Choice and the Strangers go to the headquarters but are stopped by Aladdin agents: Foxfire, Dirt Devil, War Eagle and a mysterious, unknown agent that some of the Strangers recognize.

This story is continued in Strangers #4.

issue_title: Friends And Enemies, Part One: The First Cut
description:
The police investigate a new ultra villain named Hardwire, who has the ability to cut things with his fingers on a molecular level. Meanwhile, Hardcase meets with the head of Choice Corporation, Bob Dixon, to get to the bottom of the problem involving chase and the ultras chasing her. Bob Dixon does not relent, but Hardcase informs him that she is under his protection. After that meeting, Rex Mundi indirectly hires Hardwire to take care of Hardcase. Meanwhile, NM-E, the robot that destroyed the Squad, has returns back to life, assimilating a young man to strengthen itself.

A backup story involving Rune is added to this issue and every issue under the Ultraverse banner for the month of October, 1993.

issue_title: Friends And Enemies, Part Two: Returning Favors
description: Choice exits a nightclub to find Hardcase gravely injured by lacerations against his chest and stomach. Hardcase is in a state between life and death like a drifting soul and can only witness when Hardwire, the ultra that hurt Hardcase, attacks. Thankfully, Choice summoned her shield ability and was safe against the attack. Choice takes Hardcase's body and brings it to a hospital so they can heal him. Hardcase believes he sees the soul of Starburst and she tells him that it was not his time to die. His regenerative abilities are ultra human so his condition stabilizes quickly. Meanwhile, Rex Mundi gives the Omega Team and Quattro a mission that wil take them to the moon. In the hospital, Hardcase and Choice are visited by the Alternate who informs the pair that Hardwire will be in a specific location later that night. Hardcase and Choice arrive at the location and defeat Hardwire, but not before Hardcase breaks both of his arms, to prevent Hardwire from killing some arresting officers. Hardcase is left wondering if he really did greet Starburst's soul earlier.

Hardcase introduces Choice to his secretary, agent and lawyer, hoping they will be able to help Choice by figuring out her past. Soon after that meeting, Hardcase and Choice go to another meeting with the Alternate, who informs them about the source of all ultra's powers and how the source is on the moon. Meanwhile, NM-E continues to stabilize himself and make himself stronger by assimilating any material that comes in handy, preferring organic material. The Alternate also reveals to Hardcase that the person behind the attack that killed the Squad, and the creator of NM-E, is Rex Mundi. The Alternate coerces Hardcase to go to the moon to get the source of power. Rex Mundi is also making plants of his own to secure the source of energy on the moon by sending the members of the Omega Team and Quattro. Hardcase and Choice are introduced by the Alternate to the members of the Solution, who will be joining them in the mission to the moon. Hardcase and Choice return to Hardcase's house when he sees an giant explosion occur on an island in the ocean, which is told in the pages of Exiles #4. The explosion creates a tidal wave that strikes against the shores of California. Hardcase and Choice try to save as many people as they can, but most of the attempt is futile as the tidal wave strikes quickly. The Alternate arrives to tell them that the explosion had something to do with events involving the moon, so they go to the space craft quickly.

After the events of Break-Thru, Hardcase, Choice and the Solution steal the space ship from Quattro and the Omega Team and leave them stranded. Gate is able to use his abilities and lands Quattro and the Omega Team in the middle of the Sahara Desert. Meanwhile, Rex Mundi is able to explode the space ship holding the Solution, Hardcase and Choice before it enters the Earth's orbit. Thankfully, the suits provided by the Alternate protect the heroes and they are able to fly back to Earth under the suit's power. Hardcase and Choice arrive at Hardcase's house to find a suitcase of money that the Alternate promised for the mission. She also leaves a letter stating that clues for Choices past could be found in the Aladdin facility in Groom Lake, the same place they entered before with the Strangers.

In a backup story, many people discuss the exploits of Solitaire.

Hardcase is back to filming his latest movie. Choice surprises Hardcase with a visit to the set when she sees him in the middle of a love scene. Choice expresses her interest in Hardcase and he expresses the same interest, but he also tells her how he has not allowed himself to feel his emotions since his girlfriend, Starburst, was placed in a coma. Some time later, Hardcase and Choice are attacked by Turf, an ultra who has a vendetta against celebrities. They defeat Turf and decide their relationship should progress to a romantic level, which it does. Hardcase visits Starburst in the hospital to tell her that he has found love after a year and how he didn't want to betray her. He left and Starburst seemed to have heard him as she cried a single tear.
5 variants were printed- newsstand w/ regular cover, regular cover polybagged w/card, silver foil title cover, silver holographic cover, and gold holographic cover.
A flashback to early adventures of Mantra

issue_title: The Doom of the Duplicate Swords!
description: Mantra meets ultraforce and she is dragged into a fight with Topaz. However, a villain is working behind lines.

issue_title: Kismet Once, Kismet Twice, Kismet Deadly

description:
A street cable car holding 59 passengers in San Francisco is struck by a mysterious lightning bolt that imbues each passenger with a super power, changing them into Ultras. Later at night, a mysterious woman with powers arrives at the scene where the lightning bolt struck, causing a commotion with people who were on the cable car and the police. Six strangers from the cable car accident step up to battle the mysterious woman when she attacks the police officers. The mysterious woman takes off into the sky, leaving the six strangers to contemplate that she may have the answers behind the reason they have ultra powers. The six figure out that she must have flew into the only cloud in the sky and decide to follow her using one of the stranger's private jet.

The Strangers finally arrives at the coordinates that Yrial gave her teammates but there's only ocean in the location. ElectroCute and Spectral are the two best equipped to search underwater so they do, looking for any clues that could reveal the secret behind Yrial's tribe and why they moved their island into the sky. Suddenly a portal opens and arms reach out to grab both ElectroCute and Spectral before the other Strangers can stop them. Soon, the portal opens again and a demon gets out of it to capture the other Strangers, but Lady Killer is able to use her snorkel to kill it. The remaining Strangers prepare themselves and enter the portal. Meanwhile, Yrial grows concerned for her teammates and for humanity at large when her Chieftan, cajoled by Zara, declares war on all people. ElectroCute and Spectral are tied up and meet Bastinado, a demon king. He explains that the only way the portal to Earth could open is if a human somehow activated from the Earth side, which the Strangers did. They soon realize that Bastinado and the demons are the reason behind Yrial's people moving to the sky. Just then, the rest of the Strangers attack, but Bastinado is able to negate their powers. However, Atom Bob used his own ability to change Bastinado's magic and he's able to fight him. Atom Bob eventually defeats Bastinado, who claims he can be patient since he's waited over 500 years already. The Strangers race back to enter the portal back to Earth but they get lost and all fall off a cliff.

Zip Zap saves the Strangers from impending death after they all fall off a cliff after running away from the demon lord, Bastinado. ElectroCute explains to the team that she knows the information they seek is there, but not in the immediate vicinity. She gives a general direction to where the source of information is and Zip Zap rushes through different locations to find it. He finally arrives to meet the Entity and pleads with the Entity to give him the information he needs. Zip Zap comes running back to the Strangers and brings them past Bastinado and back to Earth, telling the team that he now has the answer to their situation.

The Strangers arrive on Sky Island to free their teammate, Yrial, from isolation. Zip Zap reveals to the Chieftan and the other sky people their history and secret of their people. When it feels like they are in a stalemate, the Chieftan releases Yrial to the Strangers, thinking perhaps that now is a time for change.

Boneyard seeks out the Strangers because his realm is accosted by demons that he believes the Strangers have freed. The Strangers realize he is discussing Bastinado and his demon legion and are about to agree with him when Mantra arrives, warning the Strangers that Boneyard is an evil person. Boneyard then takes the opportunity to kidnap Atom Bob because of his incredible power and disappears through a breach. Mantra and the Strangers team up to chase after Boneyard and battle his wives and his soldiers, including Notch. When the Strangers and Mantra defeat them, Boneyard uses the power he has stolen from Atom Bob and opens a breach for Bastinado and his demons to leave them on Earth instead of his own realm.

This story continues in Mantra #12

Atom Bob and Grenade return to their old neighborhood to visit and hang out on their free time. Atom Bob wants to visit a bookstore but Grenade resists, opting instead to sign autographs for some adoring fans. Before too long, a man named Powerhouse arrives at the scene and battles Grenade and Atom Bob. Powerhouse hits Atom Bob hard and Grenade fights him with a fury. Powerhouse is an ultra that was struck by his own Jumpstart many years ago. While Grenade and Powerhouse fight, an invisible man named Pilgrim shows up and gets Powerhouse's personal information from the clothes and wallet he left hidden in an alley. Pilgrim claims that he will use this information to destroy the Strangers. Atom Bob comes back into the fight and Powerhouse flees. Grenade reveals to Bob after the fight that the reason he didn't want to enter the bookstore is because he was caught stealing years ago. However, he has learned responsibility and has become a better person, giving the money he owed to the bookstore owner.

The Strangers are in a meeting, figuring out that there are still several people from the cable car incident that are not accounted for. The group adjourns and Yrial asks if she can accompany Zip Zap back to his neighborhood. He allows her to and they begin speaking about Zip Zap's past. Suddenly they are attacked by Gangsta and Brazen, two super-powered thugs that run some gangs in that neighborhood. Yrial is able to discern their weakness and defeats them while Zip Zap beats up his old gang. Surprisingly, Pilgrim arrives with Byter, his lackey, to take Gangsta and Brazen away to join a gang he is assembling. Yrial and Zip Zap rush to inform the rest of the Strangers this development.

The Strangers all attend a block party that is being held at the home of Atom Bob's parents. Before they can join the festivities, they have a meeting about Pilgrim and the threat that looms from his recent activies. Meanwhile, three ultras, Generator X, Lightshow and Rodent, who gained their ability during the Jumpstart decide to crash the party and fight the Strangers, so they could make a name for themselves. The Strangers defeat the trio when Pilgrim and Byter suddenly arrive to recruit the three fallen ultras.

The Strangers meet together to discuss the issues arising with Pilgrim, an ultra who is intent on destroying the Strangers. Lady Killer then holds a fashion show, unveiling her new line of clothes that are inspired by the Strangers. While at the fashion show, Rafferty arrives to kill an ultra. His victim is Elena LaBrava herself and when he attempts to murder her, he is stopped by Spectral. Rafferty gets an opportunity to escape, knowing he can't take on all of the Strangers, and is able to kill an elderly woman who was on the cable car during the Jumpstart, making her an ultra. Soon after the murder, Pilgrim and Byter arrive to recruit Rafferty, but Rafferty is the first to refuse him. While Rafferty and Pilgrim fight, Atom Bob jumps in and fights Pilgrim. Byter bites Atom Bob, providing a distraction for them to escape.

Pilgrim continues to recruit others to destroy the Strangers, and his newest recruits are Zara of Sky Island and Powerhouse. Meanwhile, ElectroCute acts strangely, rebuffing Grenade's advances. She angrily leaves their base and she takes Grenade's car for a drive. Unsure as to why she gets at her destination, she finds Teknight and Byter enter a building. Pilgrim and his Gang come out, causing ElectroCute to believe that Teknight and Pilgrim are one and the same. Meanwhile, back at the Strangers headquarters, the Strangers are attacked by Scar and his Raiders. The surprise attack proves to be a winning tactic as the Strangers lose the battle. Before too long, though, Pilgrim and his Gang arrive and fight the Raiders. Pilgrim's Gang defeats the Raiders strictly because they want to pleasure to kill the Strangers. When they are given the opportunity, Pilgrim decides that this isn't the time to kill the Strangers yet, to be patient. Just then, the Strangers wake up from being knocked out and ElectroCute arrives to inform her teammates that she believes Teknight and Pilgrim are the same. However, Teknight tries to find the Strangers to warn them of Pilgrim's attacks.

On Christmas Eve, the Strangers deal with the betrayal of Atom Bob. Lady Killer and Grenade take the betrayal the hardest and some of the Strangers try to make sense of it and find ways to help Atom Bob. Lady Killer decides she needs some time alone and walks outside. She is attacked by the Grip but she is able to defeat him with the help of Teknight. The Strangers arrive and decide to have Teknight join them, replacing Atom Bob and becoming the newest Stranger.

The six strangers that banded together take a plane into the air of San Francisco to chase after a mysterious woman they all fought previously. They finally find her in the only cloud that hovers in the sky and find that there is an island hidden in the cloud that houses a total tribe. While there, the group learn that the mysterious woman, Yrial, had nothing to do with the lightning bolt that gave them their powers. As a matter of fact, Yrial defied her tribe and went to San Francisco to investigate the phenomenon. The tribal chief decided that Yrial should continue to find the source of the lightning bolt that imbued everyone with abilities and decrees that she goes with the team to be a witness to the answer. The team call themselves the Strangers and figure out what to do next.

Meanwhile, the driver of the Miata that was struck with the cable car is still in critical condition and surprisingly still alive. Also, J.D. Hunt, a rich and ruthless business man who created the android, ElectroCute, that gained sentience during the cable car accident and joined the Strangers, makes devious plans to get her back.

issue_title: The Name Of The Game Is Fear!
description: M.C. Zed and Beater, two ultras that were bestowed their powers due to the Jumpstart, kidnap the child of a former basketball player, Missile Monroe. They are working for Monroe's own brother. They make plans to meet so Missile could pay the ransom. Zip Zap of the Strangers, having met Missile the same day he found out about the kidnapping, decides to assist and goes to the ransom spot to help save the day. Zip Zap is able to defeat M.C. Zed and Beater and Missile's son is safe.

Lady Killer and Yrial decide to take Atom Bob to Europe so they can find a cure for his mental instability. Meanwhile, the other Strangers stay behind to figure things out. ElectroCute tells everyone they should take a long drive together and she rushes to get the car. As soon as she starts it, the car explodes. ElectroCute is in bad shape and her android body cannot heal itself in its current shape. Realizing the only one that could save her is J.D. Hunt, the Strangers make moves to hold J.D. Hunt while his scientist, Waddell, fixes ElectroCute. Waddell does his job and ElectroCute's body is healed. However, she immediately attacks her teammates and it seems that Waddell was able to reprogram her during the healing process.

The Strangers, minus Lady Killer and Yrial who are on a trip to save Atom Bob, figure out a way to help ElectroCute, who has been programmed to be in the control of NuWare. Guy Hunt makes moves that proves to himself that he is ready to take over in his father's stead and is even visited by Rex Mundi. The Strangers finally save the day, figure out a way to revert ElectroCute back and return J.D. Hunt.

Lady Killer and Yrial deliver Atom Bob to Andorra, to a confidential medical clinic that could help Bob with his inflictions that has changed him into Pilgrim. After leaving him in the care of Doctor Horla, Lady Killer and Yrial decide to remain in Andorra and take some much needed time off for vacation. While in a restaurant, a man named Paul Ntumbo mistakingly believes that Lady Killer and Yrial were sent by someone from Africa to apprehend him. They fight in the mountains of Andorra, which eventually triggers an avalanche. Yrial and Lady Killer escape, believing Taboo is stuck in the snow, but Taboo also escapes vowing revenge.

The Strangers all meet together and exchange stories, how Yrial and Lady Killer met an ultra named Taboo in Europe and how the others had to fight ElectroCute who was temporarily reprogrammed by J.D. Hunt's company. Meanwhile Paul Ntumbo, also known as Taboo, learns about the Strangers on his flight to America. He also learns about their first foes, TNTNT, and it sparks an interest in him to meet them. Taboo finds TNTNT and propositions them to destroy the Strangers, to which they agree. Taboo then takes the place of Torso, who was killed by Rafferty. TNTNT attacks the Strangers at their headquarters and the battle quickly escalates. TNTNT is defeated but they escape, leaving the Strangers to celebrate their victory.

This is the last issue of The Strangers
The Strangers face J.D. Hunt's hired guns, TNTNT.

issue_title: Between A Rock And A Hardcase
description:
continued from Hardcase #4

The Strangers, Hardcase and Choice are being held captive by the secret American government program called the Aladdin project. The combined ultras break free and strike a deal with Aladdin that neither would interfere with each other's goals.

The Strangers enjoy well-deserved down time, so each member goes back to their personal lives, dealing with their life as an ultra. Atom Bob visits his welcoming family, but a plethora of media surrounds their home. Grenade and Electrocute go to Grenade's home as well, but decides to not entertain the media cameras and instead opt for a walk in the neighborhood, expressing their mutual attraction. Zip Zap returns to his neighborhood and takes care of some gang members that have harassed him for years. Lady Killer returns to her company office to handle some business affairs and the future of the Strangers. Spectral visits a friend in the hospital, hoping his new ultra ability would be able to heal him. Yrial hears a woman screaming in the streets and finds that the woman was on the cable car that changed the Strangers into ultras. The woman, Henrietta Hawkins, claims that someone killed everyone on her block, someone named Deathwish. Yrial contacts the other Strangers to investigate the disturbance. There the Strangers find a trail of corpses that have been reduced to a crumbling, rotting state. That's when Deathwish shows himself, battling the Strangers. The battle seems to be pointless as Deathwish can't be hurt until Spectral arrives. He uses his growing ability to cause Deathwish to explode. Spectral then reveals to the team that he is gay and the friend he tried to save earlier actually died because he advanced his friend's disease as well as his friend's body. The Strangers offer support and unite as friends as well as teammates.

In a back-up story, the origin of Rune is told.

After the battle against Deathwish, the Strangers stay to help clean up the mess that happened in the fight. During their clean-up, the Strangers come across a live victim, Mr. Bushnell, who was on the cable car when the Jumpstart occurred. Lady Killer, Yrial and Zip Zap accompany the man to the hospital to see if he could tell them more about Deathwish. In the same hospital, Henrietta Hawkins begins to scream that the darkness has entered the building. It is at that moment that Deathwish escapes from Mr. Bushnell's body. Zip Zap is able to lead Deathwish into the morgue, but he escapes. Lady Killer contacts the other Strangers for help. Zip Zap and Lady Killer are ready to chase after Deathwish, but Yrial decides to stay and becomes belligerent. Zip Zap and Lady Killer leave and Yrial goes to visit Henrietta Hawkins. Yrial begins a magical spell while the Strangers continue to battle Deathwish. Electrocute is the only Stranger who is able to get close to Deathwish because she is an android. She savagely attacks Deathwish as Yrial continues her spell, eventually summoning the Lady of Light from Henrietta's body, an opposite of Deathwish. The Lady of Light goes to Deathwish and explains who she is, and who he really is, and they embrace, disappearing before the Strangers, leaving them to ponder how many other ultras are in the world.

continued from Prototype #5

The Strangers are on a Russian space station where they are attacked by an alien creature. Prototype, Empire-7 and Supra arrive to stop the Strangers but instead help them fight the alien. When the alien threat is temporarily stopped, Prototype goes on the offensive against the Strangers, demanding that they return the space shuttle back to J.D. Hunt, the rightful owner. Spectral learns that his indigo color give him the ability to survive in outer space, meaning that whatever created the Jumpstart wanted them to journey to the moon. The Strangers tell them that they need to investigate the moon to find the origin of all ultras and Prototype is convinced to join them. They all split up to take care of the alien menace and Empire-7 is killed by one. Thinking of only one way to destroy the aliens, Supra stays behind with a detonator while the Strangers and Prototype leave to the moon. Supra sacrifices herself in the explosion.

The Strangers return from space after the events of Break-Thru and learning the origin of their ultra powers. An official from Aladdin, Mister Leopold, arrives at their landing to interrogate them, but the Strangers will not be questioned by him after they dealt with Aladdin previously. Thankfully, an official of the military arrives and grants them leave. Soon afterwards the Chieftan of Yrial's clan arrives to tell her that she has to go back to their Sky Island, her time with the Strangers is over. Yrial refuses and fights the Chieftan, but she soon sees folly in her ways and goes with him. The Strangers follow Yrial and the Chieftan to Sky Island to free her. The Strangers fight natives of Sky Island while freeing Yrial, but she does not want to see her friends get hurt. Yrial surrenders to the Chieftan and the Strangers leave after Yrial's pleading. While leaving the island, Lady Killer finds a rock with coordinates carved in them that Yrial placed in her pocket. The Strangers decide to go to the coordinates to find where Yrial was secretly leading them.

The Strangers travel to the Carribean to find the coordinates that Yrial secretly slipped to Lady Killer before she was forced to remain on her tribe's island in the sky. The Strangers take the opportunity of being in the tropics by stopping on an island and enjoying some rest and relaxation, something they've been lacking since acquiring their abilities. The Strangers, in civilian garb, are observed by a gang of pirates that have acquired ultra abilities on the same cable car that the Strangers did. A contingency of the Pirates arrive on the Stranger's yacht and demand their money, surprised that their 'victims' have ultra powers as well. The two factions fight in a heated battle that takes place both on the Stranger's yacht and the island they were relaxing on. Meanwhile, Yrial overhears a fellow tribesman try to convince the Chieftan that they should destroy mankind. Eventually the Strangers defeat the Pirates. While some Strangers are left to ponder how both teams started in the same way but took completely different routes in life, they guide their yacht to the coordinates to find the secret behind Yrial's tribe.

Johnny Domino survives the car accident he suffered through and thanks the doctor who saved his life. When walking home from the hospital, Johnny Domino can hear a man's thoughts that indicate he wants to kill a woman. Alarmed, Johnny believes he may be going crazy because of the hunk of metal that is still embedded in his brain, but decides to investigate this man in case he isn't insane. He follows the man to a restaurant and overhears the man set up a date with the waitress there for the upcoming Saturday. Johnny leaves the area and rushes home to decide what to do where he comes into contact with two burglars. Donning a costume, Johnny Domino defeats the two burglars, proving to himself that he has what it takes to face a killer if he needs to. On that Saturday, Johnny visits the restaurant that the killer form the other day visited and tried to make a date with the same waitress, but she refused due to her prior commitment. However, she informs Johnny that her name is Ginger Robinson and that she is listed in the phone book. Johnny then leaves to visit his father before he goes to Ginger's house as Night Man, to prevent her from being killed. When he sees Ginger, he tries to warn her of the killer but finds that the killer's thoughts are coming from Ginger herself. It takes a few moments for Night Man to learn that the killer has already killed Ginger and has cut her face off, using it as a mask. The killer, now known as Deathmask, escapes on a boat and Night Man follows suit. They battle in the middle of the ocean, where blood that has dropped into the water attracts some sharks. Night Man pushes Deathmask into the water, presumably to his death. While Night Man ponders on a cape to keep himself warm, Deathmask's fist rises past the surface of the water.

In a back-up story, the origin of Rune is revealed.
